summary:
I built and refined Summit, a SaaS crypto algo trading platform with AI and neural network components, focusing on wallet-group management, LLM-based judge integration for quorum and sentiment, copy trading features, and backtesting infrastructure. I also developed j-uni-hid, a feature-rich firmware for ESP32-S3 that emulates mouse and keyboard over USB and BLE, iterating through multiple versions to improve reliability and add new capabilities. Additionally, I created input-driver, a Windows kernel-mode input filter driver with injection support, and built a comprehensive integration test suite.

In parallel, I conducted extensive research on crypto price prediction models in crypto-model-research, running systematic experiments with conformal prediction, drift monitoring, and model cataloging. I built agent-harness, an agentic worker framework in Rust that integrates with Mattermost and provides a schema-driven architecture for agents and integrations. I also worked on poker-cv, a computer vision pipeline for extracting hand history from poker platform videos, achieving high accuracy on card and action detection.

Other notable projects include intag2, a Windows Explorer file-tagging utility with support for multiple metadata formats; sunflower, a browser-in-a-browser infrastructure for secure remote browsing; j-tts-android, an Android TTS engine supporting multiple models and Russian language features; and ozwil-android, an on-device LLM app with phone use capabilities and sub-agent delegation. I also maintained various smaller projects like MEMU3, yolo-labeler, and dotfiles.

items.title: Wallet group and auth improvements on Summit
items.description: Reworked wallet-group proposal execution and settlement, extended session persistence, and optimized the scanner to skip already-evaluated lanes.

items.title: YOLO labeler updates
items.description: Continued development on the personal YOLO labeling tool, adding validator features and general improvements.

items.title: LLM judge and copy trading refinements on Summit
items.description: Integrated LLM-based judge seats for quorum and sentiment, added TypeSafe System One provider, and fixed copy trading floor logic and wallet-group limits.

items.title: Intag2 tag writing and UI scaling
items.description: Extended file tagging support to Ogg, Matroska, and WebP formats, and added user zoom level and DPI-aware UI scaling.

items.title: Agent-harness Mattermost integration and schema
items.description: Built Mattermost connector and schema-driven agent architecture, enabling feed reading, sync, and tenant-based visibility.

items.title: Sunflower font management and browser lifecycle
items.description: Improved font pack delivery and browser lifecycle management, fixing font build issues and adding automatic shutdown of idle browsers.

items.title: Follows and rebalance features on Summit
items.description: Built interactive exit simulator, trailing slider, and calm-liquidity basket for copy trading, and reworked rebalance logic with floor silencing.

items.title: Crypto model research and validation
items.description: Conducted systematic model cataloging, drift monitoring, and conformal prediction experiments, culminating in a benchmark freeze and validation response package.

items.title: Agent-harness core architecture and UI
items.description: Built the core agent framework with journal, reminders, private chats, and a web UI with admin page and settings.

items.title: Sunflower human input and deployment
items.description: Implemented human-like movement planning, permission prompt handling, and deployment infrastructure with TLS termination.

items.title: Intag2 release workflow and Vorbis support
items.description: Simplified the release pipeline, added Vorbis comment writing for Ogg formats, and fixed silent metadata write failures and uninstall path.

items.title: New trading strategies for Freqtrade
items.description: Developed and added several new pack-relative and BTC-relative reversion strategies for the Freqtrade bot.

items.title: CV generation tooling improvements
items.description: Enhanced the automated CV generation pipeline with LLM model override, voice enforcement, and dry-run mode.

items.title: Jolt input automation tool
items.description: Developed a minimal AutoHotKey alternative with interception support, scenario engine, and condition-based rules.

items.title: j-uni-hid v13 firmware updates
items.description: Released v13 of the ESP32-S3 HID firmware with fire-and-forget USB HID events and an 8x8 matrix variant.

items.title: Input-driver library and integration tests
items.description: Added push-style event listener API, relaxed security descriptor, and built a comprehensive integration test suite for the Windows input filter driver.

items.title: j-tts-android engine overhaul
items.description: Overhauled the Android TTS engine: added pitch and intonation controls, removed proprietary engines, and integrated new Russian voices with Piper and TeraTTS.

items.title: MEMU3 YOLO inference and mode changes
items.description: Refactored YOLO object detection to use DirectML, removed linger mode, and improved bow/flick tracking with bezier motion.

items.title: Poker CV pipeline development
items.description: Built a computer vision pipeline for extracting hand history from poker platform videos, achieving high accuracy on card and action detection.

items.title: Ozwil Android LLM app with sub-agent delegation
items.description: Developed an on-device LLM app with phone use capabilities, implementing sub-agent delegation, tool routing, and background service architecture.

items.title: MEMU3 aim assist and overlay development
items.description: Continued development on the mouse/keyboard emulation tool, adding YOLO-based aim assist, D3D11 overlay, and various mode improvements.

items.title: j-uni-hid v10-v11 firmware iterations
items.description: Developed multiple firmware versions for ESP32-S3 HID emulation, adding BLE support, touch, and USB digitizer, with extensive debugging and optimization.

items.title: Auto-claude autonomous coding agent
items.description: Built an autonomous multi-session AI coding tool with squash merging, git rules system, and task management UI.

items.title: MEMU3 early development
items.description: Initial development of the mouse/keyboard emulation tool with USB HID rate limiting and aim assist integration.

items.title: Freqtrade monitoring app
items.description: Developed a Flutter mobile app for monitoring Freqtrade bot performance with charts and card UI.

items.title: pAssistant Telegram bot development
items.description: Maintained and updated the personal Telegram assistant bot with summarization, forwarding, and logging features.
